level_1: Acquires a comprehensive and developmentally appropriate pediatric medical history
Independently requests additional information to supplement available medical records
level_2: Reviews available medical records
Efficiently integrates the patient history with the complete medical record, supplemental information, and tailored assessment of potential endocrine disorders
level_3: Acquires an endocrine history and a comprehensive pediatric medical history, including pubertal development and other pertinent positives and negatives
Is identified as a peer resource in interpreting subtleties and recognizing ambiguities in the patient history
level_4: Identifies relevant findings in the medical record
level_5: Acquires a tailored endocrine history, including growth, historical subtleties, and psychosocial aspects

level_1: Performs a developmentally appropriate complete physical examination, with awareness of patient comfort
level_2: Performs a developmentally appropriate complete physical examination using strategies to optimize patient comfort and identifies abnormal endocrine findings
level_3: Performs a tailored physical examination using strategies to optimize patient comfort and identifies subtle abnormal endocrine findings
level_4: Detects, pursues, and integrates key physical examination findings to distinguish nuances among competing, often similar diagnoses
level_5: Is identified as a peer resource for performing tailored physical exams, maximizing patient comfort

level_1: Reports and implements management plans developed by others for routine endocrine presentations
level_2: Develops and implements management plans that require modification for routine endocrine presentations
level_3: Develops and implements management plans for routine endocrine presentations
level_4: Develops and implements management plans for complex endocrine presentations, and modifies plans as necessary
level_5: Is identified as a peer resource for development of management plans for complex endocrine presentations, and modifies plans as necessary

subcompetencies.name: Diagnostic Testing, Including Labs, Imaging, and Functional Testing

level_1: Orders non-targeted tests for patients with routine endocrine presentations
Interprets targeted test results for patients with complex endocrine presentations, with assistance, and identifies incongruencies
level_2: Interprets basic endocrine test results, with guidance
Develops individualized cost-effective testing strategies to evaluate patients with complex endocrine presentations and avoids unnecessary testing
level_3: Orders targeted tests for patients with routine endocrine presentations
Resolves incongruencies and accepts ambiguity in targeted test results for patients with complex endocrine presentations
level_4: Independently interprets targeted test results for routine endocrine presentations
Identifies, critically evaluates, and selectively uses emerging and investigational tests or procedures; questions and reports unknown and unexplained discrepancies
level_5: Orders targeted tests for patients with complex endocrine presentations

level_1: Responds to consultation after receiving assistance
Recognizes disease acuity and prioritizes management steps
level_2: Recognizes disease acuity, with supervision
Provides comprehensive and prioritized recommendations, including assessment, rationale, and anticipatory guidance to all relevant health care team members
level_3: Clarifies the clinical questions and provides preliminary recommendations to the requesting practitioner
Mobilizes resources based on acuity of the situation
level_4: Independently recognizes disease acuity
Is identified as a peer resource for the provision of consultative care across the spectrum of disease complexity and acuity
level_5: Seeks and integrates input from different members of the health care team and provides recommendations to the requesting practitioner in a clear and timely manner

level_1: Demonstrates generalized knowledge of physiological and pathophysiological concepts in endocrinology
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of physiology and pathophysiology of routine endocrine conditions
level_3: Applies knowledge of physiology and pathophysiology to diagnosis and management of routine presentations
level_4: Applies knowledge of physiology and pathophysiology to diagnosis and management of complex presentations
level_5: Synthesizes newly described and emerging clinical physiology and pathophysiology concepts with diagnosis and management

level_1: Organizes and accurately summarizes information obtained from the patient evaluation to develop a clinical impression
Synthesizes subtle, unusual, or conflicting findings to prioritize differential diagnoses in complex endocrine presentations
level_2: Integrates information from all sources to develop a basic differential diagnosis for routine endocrine presentations
Continually re-appraises own clinical reasoning to improve patient care in real time
level_3: Identifies clinical reasoning errors within patient care, with guidance
Coaches others to develop prioritized differential diagnoses in complex endocrine presentations
level_4: Develops a thorough and prioritized differential diagnosis for routine endocrine presentations
Models how to recognize errors and reflect upon one’s own clinical reasoning
level_5: Retrospectively applies clinical reasoning principles to identify errors

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of basic endocrine therapeutics
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of the indications, monitoring parameters, and adverse effects of endocrine therapeutics
level_3: Applies knowledge of therapeutics to the management of patients with routine endocrine conditions
level_4: Applies knowledge of therapeutics to the management of patients with complex endocrine conditions
level_5: Identifies targeted or experimental therapies for complex and rare clinical scenarios

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common patient safety events
Participates in disclosure of patient safety events to patients and families (simulated or actual)
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of how to report patient safety events
Conducts analysis of patient safety events and offers error prevention strategies (simulated or actual)
level_3: Identifies system factors that lead to patient safety events
Discloses patient safety events to patients and families (simulated or actual)
level_4: Reports patient safety events through institutional reporting systems (simulated or actual)
Actively engages teams and processes to modify systems to prevent patient safety events
level_5: Participates in analysis of patient safety events (simulated or actual)
Role models or mentors others in the disclosure of patient safety events

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of basic quality improvement methodologies and metrics
level_2: Describes local quality improvement initiatives (e.g., insulin management, screening for diabetes complications)
level_3: Participates in local quality improvement initiatives
level_4: Demonstrates the skills required to identify, develop, implement, and analyze a quality improvement project
level_5: Creates, implements, and assesses quality improvement initiatives at the institutional or community level

subcompetencies.name: System Navigation for Patient Centered Care – Coordination of Care

level_1: Lists the various interprofessional individuals involved in the patient’s care coordination
level_2: Coordinates care of patients in routine clinical situations, incorporating interprofessional teams with consideration of patient and family needs
level_3: Coordinates care of patients in complex clinical situations, effectively utilizing the roles of interprofessional teams, and incorporating patient and family needs and goals
level_4: Coordinates interprofessional, patient-centered care among different disciplines and specialties, actively assisting families in navigating the health care system
level_5: Coaches others in interprofessional, patient- centered care coordination

subcompetencies.name: System Navigation for Patient-Centered Care – Transitions in Care

level_1: Uses a standard template for transitions of care/hand-offs
level_2: Adapts a standard template, recognizing key elements for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in routine clinical situations
level_3: Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations, and ensures closed-loop communication
level_4: Performs and advocates for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs within and across health care delivery systems, including transitions to adult care
level_5: Coaches others in improving transitions of care within and across health care delivery systems to optimize patient outcomes

level_1: Demonstrates awareness of population and community health needs
level_2: Identifies specific population and community health needs; identifies local resources
level_3: Uses local resources effectively to meet the needs of a patient population and community
level_4: Adapts practice to provide for the needs of of a specific population
level_5: Advocates at the local, regional, or national level for populations and communities with health care needs

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems

level_1: Engages with patients and other providers in discussions about cost- conscious care and key components of the health care delivery system
level_2: Identifies the relationships between the delivery system and cost- conscious care and the impact on the patient care
level_3: Discusses the need for changes in clinical approaches based on evidence, outcomes, and cost-effectiveness to improve care for patients and families
level_4: Advocates for the promotion of safe, quality, and high-value care
level_5: Coaches others to promote safe, quality, and high-value care across health care systems

level_1: Develops an answerable clinical question and demonstrates how to access available evidence, with guidance
level_2: Independently articulates clinical question and accesses available evidence
level_3: Locates and applies the evidence, integrated with patient preference, to the care of patients
level_4: Critically appraises and applies evidence, even in the face of uncertainty and conflicting evidence to guide care tailored to the individual patient
level_5: Coaches others to critically appraise and apply evidence for complex patients

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth

level_1: Participates in feedback sessions

level_2: Develops personal and professional goals, with assistance
Seeks and incorporates feedback and performance data consistently
level_3: Demonstrates openness to feedback and performance data

level_4: Designs a learning plan based on established goals, feedback, and performance data, with assistance
Role models and coaches others in seeking and incorporating feedback and performance data
level_5: Seeks and incorporates feedback and performance data episodically
Demonstrates continuous self-reflection and coaching of others on reflective practice

level_1: Identifies expected professional behaviors and potential triggers for lapses

level_4: Demonstrates accountability for patient care as a pediatric endocrinologist, with guidance
Models professional behavior and coaches others when their behavior fails to meet professional expectations
level_5: Maintains professional behavior in increasingly complex or stressful situations
Extends the role of the pediatric endocrinologist beyond the care of patients by engaging with the community, specialty, and medical profession as a whole

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of the ethical principles underlying informed consent, surrogate decision making, advance directives, confidentiality, error disclosure, stewardship of limited resources, and related topics

level_5: Called upon by others to consult in cases of complex ethical dilemmas; identifies and seeks to address system- level factors that induce or exacerbate

level_1: Performs tasks and responsibilities, with prompting

level_3: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a thorough and timely manner in complex or stressful situations
level_4: Coaches others to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed in a thorough and timely manner in complex or stressful situations

level_1: Recognizes the importance of addressing personal and professional well-being
